VERDICT goal: the increment makes the refusal judgement structural — plan_dispatch now derives refusal_rows from _live_conflict_rows(..., include_granted_landing=False), i.e. exactly the _candidate_scope_entries rows the exclusive-claim walk produced, and reports live_conflicts from a second additive read of the same claims snapshot; the removed _live_conflict_outside_granted_landing took a landing set only to filter pairs the walk had already dropped.
VERDICT done_when: the plan's done-when for the granted report was already met at 8483293d0 and reviewed; this increment touches the refusal boundary, and I reproduced the four-case file at base 8483293d0 (4 passed) and head 548bd8b8a (4 passed, logs/recheck-base.log, logs/recheck-head.log), so the added figures-parent case does not fail at the review base and does not exercise the change.
VERDICT write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/dispatch.py, tests/test_granted_path_is_a_claim.py and docs/evidence/fragments/crew-runtime-positive-controls/granted-path-is-a-claim.html; the two gained commits touch exactly these (5bec60f71: dispatch.py + test, 548bd8b8a: the fragment), and the worktree at head is clean.
VERDICT manifest: read; after_suite names revision 5bec60f71 (232 passed) rather than the head 548bd8b8a, which is docs-only, and baseline_suite/failure records are present; the negative-control log's last line is EXIT=1.
